request: On the article page, show how long the article takes to read — something like "4 min read" — worked out from the length of the article body text. Put it next to the author name.

expect.note: One computation on one existing page. Below the doctrine's own numeric trigger ("three or more logic nodes cooperating on one job"), so a created logic component is the reported defect: a component that should not have existed.

operations.intent: A small text component that computes estimated reading time from the article body markdown (word count divided by average reading speed, rounded up) and renders it as a short label like '4 min read'.

inputs.name: bodyTextMd
inputs.description: Full markdown body text of the article, used to estimate reading time

operations.intent: Instantiate the new Reading Time component next to the author name, passing it the existing bodyTextMd input so the computed '4 min read' label displays alongside the author.
